拐子狼

SO THIS IS THE WAY · WORDS & PHOTOS & FILMS

眼睛里只有光与影，
脑子里全是蒙太奇。

笔墨和镜头里的故事，文字或影像外的可能。

我是拐子狼。写诗歌。写科幻。写文学。写商业观察。写非虚构。做设计。做学问。做教程。拍短片。拍自媒体。拍 AIGC 。

灵光一闪 Fleeting ideas

创作是烧灼在大脑中私奔的火苗。

BEHIND THE WORK打开命定之敌 AntiChrist

在未来的某个世界，人类已全面撤出太阳系。地球和月球基地上，留守着克隆人和遵循机器人三定律的不同代际的机器人。资源将尽，矛盾不可调和，以月球为首的机器人新政府公开向克隆人宣战。

In a future world, humanity has left the solar system. Clones and generations of robots bound by the Three Laws remain on Earth and the Moon. As resources dwindle and conflicts become irreconcilable, the Moon’s robot government declares war on the clones.

创作手记
BEHIND THE WORK打开五分钟动态演绎

我的多数软件技术都是自学，依托早期互联网的开源分享精神，从许多大佬的教程中学到很重要的知识。Keynote 是我研究最精深的软件，基于对开源精神的回报，我把相关思路也做成教学分享。

Most of my software skills are self-taught, thanks to the sharing spirit of the early internet and the tutorials of generous creators. Keynote is the software I have studied most deeply. To give something back, I shared my methods through tutorials.

创作手记
BEHIND THE WORK打开回县城去：青年维特的烦恼

二百五十年前，歌德写等级森严下的德国社会里，少年维特挫折的爱情和事业，以及诸多的烦恼。这烦恼究竟是维特的烦恼，还是少年的烦恼？到今天我也没搞明白。歌德写维特，其实是写自己。我大概也是。两百多年了，这份烦恼还在继续。

Two hundred and fifty years ago, Goethe wrote about young Werther’s frustrated love and career in Germany’s rigid social order. Are these Werther’s sorrows, or the sorrows of youth? I still do not know. Goethe was writing about himself. Perhaps I was too. Two centuries later, the sorrow continues.

创作手记
g.STORIESBEHIND THE WORK北疆 · 富蕴

醒来就能望见远处的雪山。富蕴四面都是山，冰雪流水的河流冷冽湍急，人们行走得小心又坚定。天是白的，山是白的，河流半结的冰块也明亮亮的。只有城市带着些色彩，人心也随着忙碌一些杂事。想象下雪原上燃烧的篝火……那光亮就是富蕴。新疆是如此之大，大到足以容纳一切。新疆是一个没有杂音的、也不向你讲道理的地方。在那里只是呼吸就足够了。骆驼不会多看你一眼，马也只是嘶鸣。雪会落下，花会开，山站在那，湖水湛蓝，宇宙自行运转。

Wake up and you can see the snowy mountains in the distance. Mountains surround Fuyun. Its rivers of ice and meltwater are cold and swift; people walk carefully, yet firmly. The sky is white, the mountains are white, and the half-frozen river shines brightly too. Only the town carries a little color, and people’s hearts grow busy with everyday errands. Imagine a bonfire burning on the snowfield… That light is Fuyun. Xinjiang is so vast that it has room for everything. It is a place without noise, a place that offers no lectures. There, breathing is enough. A camel will not give you a second glance; a horse simply neighs. Snow falls, flowers bloom, mountains stand, lakes are blue, and the universe turns on its own.

BEHIND THE WORK打开出道十二年，微信依然小而美？

曾经标榜「小而美」的微信，是如何成长为今日的庞然大物的？
我梳理了过去十二年来微信遭遇的关键事件，以小见大地回看了中文移动互联网的发展过程。

How did WeChat, once described as “small and beautiful,” become so vast?
I traced key events over twelve years of its history to revisit the development of China’s mobile internet.

创作手记
BEHIND THE WORK打开中文播客的前世今生

这篇文章囊括了我对中文播客的绝大部分经验和看法。也成为一份早期播客圈的知识备份。获得了小宇宙 CEO Kyth、少数派 CEO 老麦等亲历者们的分享推荐，随后被多家知名媒体引用。

This essay gathers most of my experience with and thoughts on Chinese podcasts. It also became a record of the early podcast community. Xioayuzhou CEO Kyth and SSPAI CEO Laomai shared and recommended it; several major media outlets later cited it.

创作手记
BEHIND THE WORK打开Joker

七点半准时起床，冷水灌半碗牙缸
霜打满一身衣裳，向着前程导航

地铁奔腾的热气，鸣笛不到我家乡
单车纵横三千米，蚂蚁筑起大厦

Up at seven thirty, cold water in a half-filled cup.
Frost covers my clothes as I navigate toward a future.

The subway rushes with hot air; its whistle never reaches my hometown.
Bicycles crisscross three kilometers; ants build the towers.

BEHIND THE WORK打开牛来自海上

数千年前秦始皇东巡到秦皇岛时，在这里命祭司宰牛、祭祀天地，并派遣方士卢生出海寻找不老仙法。卢生的船队在海上漂泊数年，遭遇疫病、海怪，最终仅卢生一人被海水冲上仙岛。在岛上，仙人给予她一头神牛，神牛渡她回到日思夜想的故乡，然而仙界一日，世上千年……

本片获得第二届海浪AI黑客松终审入围

Thousands of years ago, during his eastern tour to Qinhuangdao, Qin Shi Huang ordered priests to sacrifice cattle and worship heaven and earth, and sent the mystic Lu Sheng to sea in search of immortality. Her fleet drifted for years, facing epidemics and sea monsters, until she alone was washed ashore on an island of immortals. There, an immortal gave her a divine ox, which carried her back to the homeland she had longed for. But one day in the immortal realm was a thousand years in the mortal world…

Selected for final review at the 2nd Hailang AI Hackathon.

BEHIND THE WORK打开播客界的京派与海派

写作于中文播客蓬勃发展的前夜。文章分为播客发展史、中文播客发展史、播客届的京派与海派、中文播客的起源、中文播客的未来几个类目。在行文中，我穿插了「我的 10 年代播客清单」，选出了 10 期我最喜欢的播客，推荐给大家。

本文获得少数派 2019 年度征文 我的 2010 年代清单赛道 三等奖

Written on the eve of Chinese podcasting’s rapid growth, this essay covers the history of podcasting, the history of Chinese podcasts, the Beijing and Shanghai schools, the origins of Chinese podcasting, and its future. Throughout the essay, I share “My Podcast List of the 2010s,” recommending ten of my favorite episodes.

Awarded Third Prize in the “My 2010s List” category of the SSPAI 2019 Essay Competition.

入围作品
g.STORIESBEHIND THE WORK失忆的鱼

世界很大，鱼缸很小
如果是一条鱼，它会落寞伤心吗？
如果是一群鱼，它会欢喜起来吗？
如果孤独有了陪伴
孤独会消失，还是继续以复数形式存在？
如果鱼的记忆真的只有七秒
它们会重复遇见彼此吗？
它们会一次又一次地爱上对方吗？
在试图寻找回记忆的无数时间里
它们会发现又再次忘掉自己吗？

The world is vast; the fish tank is small
Would a single fish feel lonely and sad?
Would a group of fish become happy?
If loneliness found company
Would it disappear, or continue to exist in the plural?
If fish really remember for only seven seconds
Would they keep meeting each other anew?
Would they fall in love with each other again and again?
Across the countless moments spent trying to recover their memories
Would they discover themselves, only to forget again?

ABOUT / ME

创作是世界上最美好的事

我是拐子狼。这个名称用了很久，最早叫「瘸狼唱残月」，瘸狼和残月就是我和世界，我和世界都不完美，但「唱」的过程充盈了彼此，解释了互相的存在。这就是创作的意义。

I’m Guaizilang. I have used this name for a long time. My earliest name was “A Lame Wolf Sings to the Waning Moon.” The wolf and the moon are me and the world. Neither of us is perfect, but the act of “singing” enriches us both and gives meaning to each other’s existence. That is what creating means to me.

KEYNOTE / MOTION STUDIES

五分钟动态演绎系列教程

以 Keynote 为载体的动态演绎系列教程，全网百万播放。

作者 · 2016

系列也发布于微信公众号与站酷。

创作往事

我的绝大多数软件技术都是自学，依托于早期互联网的开源分享精神，从许多大佬的教程中学到很重要的知识。Keynote 可能是我人生中最重要的一个软件，也是我研究最精深的软件，不夸张地说我对 Keynote 的理解应该是所有用户中最深度的之一。基于对开源精神的回报，我把相关思路也做成了教学分享出来。

在未来的某个世界，人类已全面撤出太阳系。地球和月球基地上，留守着克隆人和遵循机器人三定律的不同代际的机器人。资源将尽，矛盾不可调和，以月球为首的机器人新政府公开向克隆人宣战，它们宣称「机器人的伟大造物——人类赋予了我们若干不可剥夺的权利……克隆人政府窃取了权柄，黑暗的统治将被全体机器人的怒火掀翻。造物主的时代早已终结，祂们遗留的精神却当被发扬光大……」随着机器人三定律纪念碑的倒塌，地月战争启幕了。就在这时，来自遥远的人类文明的时空旅人、素有赌徒称号的流浪者尼莫西斯，驾驶着他的红色幽灵号，意外回到了人类起源之地……

An AI science-fiction short film. Director, editor and co-writer.

Director / Co-writer · 2026

Behind the work

In a future world, humanity has withdrawn from the solar system. Earth and the Moon are left to clones and generations of robots bound by the Three Laws of Robotics. With resources running out and conflicts irreconcilable, a robot government on the Moon declares war on the clones. It invokes rights granted by its creators and denounces the clone government’s rule. As the monument to the Three Laws falls, the Earth–Moon war begins. Then Nemesis, a wanderer and gambler from a distant human civilization, unexpectedly returns to humanity’s birthplace aboard his Red Ghost.

作者 · 2025

创作往事

在 2025 年末，我一个人去新疆玩了 24 天，辗转南疆北疆，去了乌鲁木齐、吐鲁番、富蕴、阿勒泰、莎车、喀什、塔县、阿克苏、伊宁、博乐等城市和地区，坐上可可托海的雪原列车，路过冬日荒野上盘踞的牛羊和马群，目睹博格达峰的日落金山，马踏天山的松木沉雪，牦牛缓步冰封的白沙湖，帕米尔高原上沉默的冰山之父，雏鸽和苍老的高台民居，喀喇昆仑如绝境长城般封堵在路的尽头，伊犁湿地的鸳鸯在黄昏里优雅抖落羽毛上的水珠，染红雪山的火烧云氤氲着赛里木湖的一池眼泪，野生北山羊在三千三百米高的风口中漫步啃食苔藓……新疆是一个没有杂音的、也不向你讲道理的地方。只是呼吸就足够了。骆驼不会多看你一眼，马也只是嘶鸣。雪会落下，花会开，山站在那，湖水湛蓝，宇宙自行运转。

摄影展示

A Xinjiang travel essay with expenses and photographs. Shortlisted for SSPAI’s 2025 annual writing competition.

Author · 2025

Behind the work

At the end of 2025, I traveled alone through Xinjiang for 24 days, across both its northern and southern regions. I visited Urumqi, Turpan, Fuyun, Altay, Shache, Kashgar, Tashkurgan, Aksu, Yining and Bole. I rode the snowfield train at Koktokay, passed cattle, sheep and horses in winter’s wilderness, and watched sunset gild Bogda Peak. There were snow-covered pines, yaks on frozen White Sand Lake, the silent Muztagh Ata, old homes in Kashgar, and the Karakoram closing off the road like a great wall. Birds shook water from their feathers in Ili’s wetlands; sunset colored Sayram Lake and the mountains. Ibex grazed in a high mountain wind. Xinjiang asks for no explanation. Breathing is enough. Camels barely glance at you; horses simply neigh. Snow falls, flowers bloom, mountains stand, water stays blue, and the universe goes on.
